correctness.rationale: The proof constructs the actual invariant conditional plane measure, counts all five-edge cuts of the pyramid graph, computes the required spherical positive-part integrals in arctangent form, and derives remaining atoms from the exact edge-crossing mean. Quadrature independently checks both integrals, while 825000 weighted plane draws validate numerical predictions across 11 geometries. Those finite checks corroborate but do not replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: A complete probability distribution, not merely a mean or isolated count, is obtained for the natural two-parameter family of right rectangular pyramids. The width-conditioned Crofton law underlies stereological inference from random physical cuts; its shape dependence and closed evaluation are not consequences of the generic edge-count expectation. The three atomic probabilities are simultaneously exact and nondegenerate for every finite positive parameter triple.
